Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: Hello there, traveler! I have a proposition for you.

Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: Excellent! I need someone to convince the town guard to let my shipment through. Are you up for the task?

Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: *impressed* You seem confident! The guard is over there. Good luck!

Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: *skeptical* Hmm, maybe this isn't such a good idea after all...

Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: Well, do your best. The guard can be quite stubborn.

Title: CharismaTest
DialogueText: Suit yourself. Maybe someone else will help me then.
